title: 🔆🔅Tehran, October 19, 2026 - Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC spokesman, made statements in a speech.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran, October 19, 2026 - Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC spokesman, made statements in a speech. "

"==========="

"SOT, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "Seven large cables pass under the Strait of Hormuz; all internet and commercial data passes through those cables. We only want them to know this. New targets will be unveiled, new weapons will be unveiled, and the result will be that we will sweep the remnants of American power out of the region.
